Line-ups: which units work

Source: R/lineups.R
lineups.Rd

Line-ups: which units work

Usage

lineups(pbp, team = NULL, min_minutes = 20)

Arguments

pbp

Play-by-play in the ggbasket layout with line-ups (see add_lineups()).

team

Teams to keep (default: all).

min_minutes

Line-ups with fewer minutes together are dropped.

Value

A tibble per team and five-player unit: min, pts_for, pts_against, ortg, drtg, net, poss.
